# Pydantic JSON Schema

> Convert JSON Schema to Pydantic models with type-safe validation

Convert JSON Schema definitions into Pydantic models with runtime validation.

- [Home](https://danipulok.github.io/pydantic-jsonschema/0.0.12/index.md)

- [Schema](https://danipulok.github.io/pydantic-jsonschema/0.0.12/schema/index.md)
- [Converters](https://danipulok.github.io/pydantic-jsonschema/0.0.12/converters/index.md)
- [Formats](https://danipulok.github.io/pydantic-jsonschema/0.0.12/formats/index.md)
